verdict.rationale: Versioning and rolling back automations is a fair question for a workflow and issue-tracking product like Linear, so the axis applies. The pack has no evidence of version history, review, or rollback for automations. The 'Diffs' review and 'Merge approved changes' items cover code review, not automation definitions, so they are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
